notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello everyone![/b] Thank you all so much for the amount of feedback we have been receiving and we are hard at work to make the demo (and by extension the whole game) better![/p][p][/p][p][i]If you have some feedback make sure to join our [url="https://discord.gg/mT4MKuCgKq"]discord server[/url].[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]ADDITIONS[/h3][list][*][p]The option to disable head bobbing has been added for people prone to motion sickness[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]BUGFIXES[/h3][list][*][p]The typo in the introduction cinematic has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer write and change the text on the credits[/p][/*][*][p]Discord server link now works[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]TWEAKS[/h3][list][*][p]The severe head tilting on certain sections in the \[spoiler] bridge \[/spoiler] has been removed[/p][/*][/list]
